## About this round

Wema Bank Hackaholics 7.0 overall winner (grand prize), N60,000,000 cash award presented at the grand finale in Lagos on 6 Nov 2026 (date\_announced = finale date per TechBuild and Guardian). Press calls it funding; recorded as Grant, consistent with the Hackaholics prize precedent (Trakka, funding 1507556). NGN only; no USD amount sourced. Winner named as Tony Niteon Nwose, founder of Niteon (TechBuild, Guardian). Article publication date 2026-11-11 (TechBuild).
